children: Across Protocol has announced that all $ACX tokens will be deprecated, losing all governance, utility, and economic function. The equity and USDC exchange options close on the same day as the deprecation, and no guaranteed rate is available afterward.

Once the windows close, unexchanged ACX holders face total loss of token value, since the token no longer carries governance rights or any economic function. This creates deadline-driven selling pressure that persists into the deprecation date. The equity and USDC options are the only stated exit paths, and both end at the same deadline. Holders intending to exchange must act before closing, because no guaranteed conversion rate exists afterward.
Across Protocol has been transferred to a new company, Across, Inc. ("AcrossCo"), and
now have two options, summarized in this article. The exchange portal is live at

title: Across Protocol: Deprecating ACX Token as Equity and USDC Exchanges Close - 08 Jan 2027
